and v give a parametric representation of a curve from P = (u(a), v(a))

to Q. Prove this analytically. Hint: This problem will give a geometric
interpretation for one of the theorems in Chapter 11. You will also need to
assume that we don’t have u'(x) = v'(x) = 0 for any x in (a,b) (compare
Problem 2).
